scope: 2025 exact S級予選, 後半, main line >=3, B rough branch
finding: A-confidence zone for possible 18->9 point narrowing
recommended_provisional_rule: If A score - strongest rival leader R1L score >= 10.0, remove R1L from first place only; otherwise retain A and R1L in first place.
interpretation: The >=10 score-gap zone is the only tested simple confidence zone with zero R1L winners in both halves. The >=8 zone still loses 4 R1L winners and is too aggressive for automatic first-place deletion.
warning: Only 8 races satisfy the >=10 rule. Treat as provisional, not a universal law. Do not lower the threshold merely to save more points.
